body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Identifies technology combinations that could create new product categories. (Proposed capability.) A convergence predictor would mine patent, paper, and product data for co-maturing technologies and forecast combination opportunities. Bibliometric forecasting is demonstrated; reliable product-category prediction is speculative. Status: speculative. Capability status: PROPOSED. This database describes a proposed capability, not a completed product. Status taxonomy used throughout: speculative (no demonstrated path), simulated (works in simulation only), experimentally-demonstrated (lab demo exists), independently-verified (reproduced by a third party). Generating a design cannot make impossible physics possible; every record states which status its claims carry. Capability status for this tool: speculative.

title: Technology Convergence Predictor — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Identifies technology combinations that could create new product categories. (Proposed capability.)
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Teaching ladder for Technology Convergence Predictor, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Co-maturation signal mining). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Co-maturation signal mining and Combination hypothesis generation. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Technology Impact Forecasting Engine) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else. Capability status for this tool: speculative.
